## Why This Is Asked
Real-world telemetry must balance cost with fidelity. This angle tests topology, guarantees for critical events, and budget-driven decisions across tenants.

## Key Concepts
- OTCA telemetry and per-tenant pricing
- Ingress-enforced sampling with guarantees
- Deterministic replay and immutable audit trail
- Cross-sink propagation (ClickHouse/BigQuery) and retention
- Testing budget bursts and drift

## Code Example
```javascript
// deterministic sampling based on seed and cost bucket
function shouldEmit(event, seed) {
  const r = mulberry32(hash(event.tenantId + event.eventType + seed));
  return event.priority === 'premium' || r < event.costBudget;
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you implement adaptive budgets for traffic spikes?
- How do you validate that critical events never drop during outages?

## Why This Is Asked

This question probes capacity planning, consistency under OTCA constraints, and real-time policy enforcement across regions.

- Versioned policy models and hot/cold policy caches

- In-region evaluation latency, streaming updates, and rollback strategies

- Immutable regional logs and auditability

- Canary rollout and burst testing

## Code Example

```javascript
function evaluatePolicy(tenantId, action, resource, policies){
  const pol = policies.find(p => p.tenantId===tenantId && p.action===action && p.resource===resource);
  return pol && pol.version && pol.rules.every(r => r.matches);
}
```

- What testing strategy would you use to simulate burst traffic and policy drift?
